news.title: Bitcoin rebounds strongly this week, trades near $84,000 after climbing above $86,000. Here is what experts say
news.description: Bitcoin rebounded to around $84,000 after briefly crossing $86,000, while Ethereum traded near $2,688. Bitcoin gained 3.6% weekly, supported by positive ETF flows and reduced uncertainty after the US Federal Reserve’s September policy decision, though markets remain in consolidation overall.
